design: D1 Focus by durable id. FR-n is per document, so links send the requirement id (spreq-...); a bare identifier is still accepted from older links. D2 Navigate without threading callbacks: goTo pushes the destination's URL and fires popstate, which the one navigation hook already handles, so any component can link to evidence. D3 The browser reverses the route's oldest-first order on purpose (what changed last reads first); its test pins that against the route's real order. D4 The job link is shown for a failed or skipped firing whose reason mentions evidence, unfocused, because a firing names no task.

limits: Built before this document was written; the acceptance drive was written alongside the build
The approval-report and job-firing links are unit-typed and rendered conditionally; neither was seen on the replica, which has no such state

problem: F672/F673: evidence was hard to find and hard to judge. It lived only in a collapsed coverage bar per document, and with vis-D1/vis-D4 the operator now inspects what agents decided rather than deciding it, so they need one place to look. Slice evidence-browser of roadmap spdoc-d882f76795b3. FR-n repeats in every document, so a requirement must be named by its durable id and its document.

requirements.rationale: Evidence had no place of its own.
requirements.statement: The Spec tab MUST offer an evidence view listing every piece of the project's evidence, reachable by URL and from a Spec rail entry showing the project's count, newest first within groups ordered by their newest piece.
The evidence view MUST filter by review state with a count per state, by agent, and by a search over summary, locator, command and requirement wording, and MUST group by requirement or by task.

requirements.rationale: FR-n repeats in every document; focusing FR-4 gathered every document's FR-4.
requirements.statement: A focus on a requirement MUST name it by its durable id and narrow to that requirement only, and the view MUST label requirement groups and the focus with the requirement's document.
Every evidence view the Hub returns MUST carry, in its requirement block, the document the requirement belongs to as its path and title.

requirements.rationale: Every place that says evidence should show it.
requirements.statement: The coverage row of a requirement with evidence, the task story's evidence summary, the approval report's awaiting-evidence entry and a job firing whose reason mentions evidence MUST each link to the evidence view focused on what they mean.

in_scope: A URL-backed evidence view on the Spec tab (?tab=spec&view=evidence[&focus=...]) and a Spec rail entry with the project's count
State filter chips with counts, an agent filter, search over summary, locator, command and wording, grouping by requirement or by task, rows opening into review history and proof
Each evidence view's requirement block names its document (path and title)
Links from the coverage row, the task story summary, the approval report's awaiting-evidence advisory, and a job firing whose reason mentions evidence
non_goals: Deciding evidence from the browser (vis-D1: agents decide, the operator inspects)

summary: A project-wide evidence browser on the Spec tab, filterable and linkable, that every mention of evidence elsewhere in the app opens focused on what it means.
